config.interpretation: Historical replication on a retrospectively selected crypto universe, not a fresh holdout. Zero-delay variants assume idealized execution at the signal close. Gross returns omit fees, funding and borrow costs.

sharpe: Arithmetic mean daily portfolio return divided by sample standard deviation, annualized by sqrt(365.25); zero cash rate
changes: Market hedge universe observed at decision date
Explicit entry, rebalance and liquidation costs
limitations: Historical sample already used by source project
Idealized same-close execution in zero-delay variants
Funding, borrow fees and availability excluded
Missing prices carried forward for valuation, not evidence of executable fills
Dollar-neutral weights do not imply market-beta neutrality
